about_the_game:
Could you deliver a giant cake or a priceless vase? How about a snowman or a fallen star?

Work together with a tiny team of robots to make your deliveries, balancing your cargo through all kinds of challenges, wild weather and puzzling obstacles. Can you reach the goal with your delivery still intact? Can you land the perfect delivery?

Join the team and play in 1 or 2 players in couch co-op. 🕹️🕹️

Team up with a buddy and grab another controller or share a keyboard. Work together to find the perfect balance to navigate your delivery through all kinds of challenges, or go head to head in VS mode.

Meet a whole host of colourful characters who all have unique jobs and challenges waiting for you. Collect team photos with all your happy customers after completing their tasks and earn bonuses for the perfect delivery.

Ready for little break from your deliveries? How about going head to head with a friend in some mini games or take on some challenges.

⚙️ - Put your flying skills to the test and see how high you can fly in the Golden Cog Challenge. Navigate your way through an endless level that generates itself randomly with obstacles while balancing a precarious cog to join the leader board, and unlock some special prizes! 🎁

⚙️ - How about a day at the beach with a friendly game of volley ball against a buddy. Use your bumper to add some extra power to the ball and see who can score the most points.

⚙️ - Delivery dash - Who will be the first to make their delivery? Each player goes head to head at the same time to see who can make it to their goal with their delivery in the speediest time.

The Cog Shop is OPEN! 🎩⚙️- You can pay a visit to the local Cog Shop, where you can spend your hard earned cogs on new items after each successful delivery. See what's in stock and give your character a new look! Also, keep an eye out for mystery boxes around levels which could hold secret items?

I'm having a really fun time working on Steady, Steady, Steady! and excited to be releasing the full game soon with new levels, game modes and a lot more hats. 🎩

If you would like to stay updated with the games development and on any other projects, you can check out my website or follow along on my socials.

Thanks a lot,

Chris - Cloud Lantern.

Welcome to the team!
